title: Sampling More Strategically But Just as Flexibly as IID
text:
Abstract
Many scientific calculations estimate an average by drawing independent, identically distributed (IID) samples. We can draw as many as we like, but chance leaves gaps and clusters. Low-discrepancy (LD) sampling spreads points more evenly and can yield more accurate answers for the same computational effort. Traditionally, however, some of its most effective methods favor particular sample sizes. I will survey recent research by our group on LD constructions that preserve the freedom to add samples as needed, while retaining the benefits of more even coverage. I will also show how QMCPy makes these ideas available for practical simulation and how AI is accelerating our research and software development.
